notes.title: Get In Timelessness is out now!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635358/71b74a13f46fd3c87107b271b615220ee7c29390.png"][/img]FANTOM INK announces the release of its first game! We are celebrating this event with joy in our hearts. We hope that you will share our overwhelming delight. ːsteamhappyː

This is our beginning, but we do not plan to stop. There is still a lot of work ahead of us and many games under the patronage of Ink![/p]
